title: The Office - Presentation Series 4 - Discussing the Competition
audio: mp3/280. The Office - Presentation Series 4 - Discussing the Competition.mp3

segments.en: Hello everyone and welcome to EnglishPod.
segments.zh: 大家好，欢迎来到 EnglishPod。

segments.en: My name is Marco.
segments.zh: 我叫 Marco。

segments.en: My name is Catherine and today's show is a continuation of our series about giving a presentation in English.
segments.zh: 我的名字是凯瑟琳，今天的节目是我们关于用英语进行演示的系列的延续。

segments.en: So we're talking about a special line of computers here.
segments.zh: 所以我们在这里谈论的是一条特殊的计算机系列。

segments.en: That's right and on this occasion we're going to compare two companies.
segments.zh: 没错，这次我们将比较两家公司。

segments.en: So we're going to try to tell everyone what the difference is between our company and the competitors.
segments.zh: 因此，我们将尝试告诉大家我们公司和竞争对手之间的区别。

segments.en: All right, so we learned a lot of great phrases and words for making comparisons in last week's show.
segments.zh: 好吧，所以我们在上周的节目中学到了很多很棒的短语和单词来进行比较。

segments.en: You're going to hear some of these again.
segments.zh: 你会再次听到其中的一些。

segments.en: Let's listen to the dialogue.
segments.zh: 让我们听对话。

segments.en: Now of course with all this cutting edge technology there must be a catch, you might ask yourself.
segments.zh: 当然，你们可能会想：用了这么多尖端技术，肯定也有什么不足吧？

segments.en: I bet the retail price will be too much for most consumers you might say.
segments.zh: 我敢打赌，您可能会说，对于大多数消费者来说，零售价太高了。

segments.en: Well you'd be wrong.
segments.zh: 好吧，你会错的。

segments.en: Yes of course the X420 is aimed at the luxury market but if you compare the price of our leading competitors the X420 represents incredible value for money.
segments.zh: 是的，当然 X420 是针对奢侈品市场的，但如果你比较我们主要竞争对手的价格，X420 代表了令人难以置信的物有所值。

segments.en: At only 15,000 RMB it is far more affordable and far more attractive than almost every leading brand and model.
segments.zh: 它仅为 15,000 元人民币，比几乎所有领先品牌和型号都更实惠、更具吸引力。

segments.en: So what differentiates us from our competitors?
segments.zh: 那么，我们与竞争对手的区别是什么？

segments.en: Well if we compare Orange's luxury MP40 range then we can really highlight some of the differences.
segments.zh: 好吧，如果我们比较 Orange 的豪华 MP40 系列，那么我们真的可以突出一些差异。

segments.en: Now of course Orange has an enviable record for producing revolutionary and top class products and I must admit the MP40 is a breathtaking machine.
segments.zh: 当然，Orange 在生产革命性和一流的产品方面拥有令人羡慕的记录，我必须承认 MP40 是一台令人叹为观止的机器。

segments.en: However for most consumers the MP40 is simply far too expensive to consider.
segments.zh: 然而，对于大多数消费者来说，MP40 实在是太昂贵了。

segments.en: Compared with the X420 it is more expensive and there's no doubt that considering the quality and workmanship that goes into the X420 we really win hands down on value for money.
segments.zh: 它比 X420 贵得多，而考虑到 X420 的品质和做工，毫无疑问，我们在性价比上占据绝对优势。

segments.en: Also if you compare the after sales service we offer I think we can proudly boast the best customer service facilities in the whole laptop sector.
segments.zh: 此外，如果您比较我们提供的售后服务，我认为我们可以自豪地拥有整个笔记本电脑领域最好的客户服务设施。

segments.en: As opposed to most of our rivals we guarantee quality, we guarantee service and we guarantee reliability.
segments.zh: 与我们的大多数竞争对手相比，我们保证质量，我们保证服务，我们保证可靠性。

segments.en: The questions we must ask ourselves are what does the Alpha brand stand for and also how can we set ourselves apart from our competitors?
segments.zh: 我们必须问自己的问题是 Alpha 品牌代表什么，以及我们如何让自己与竞争对手区分开来？

segments.en: The answer to both of these questions is the same my friends.
segments.zh: 这两个问题的答案都是一样的，我的朋友们。

segments.en: Alpha stands first and foremost for quality, for excellence and for service.
segments.zh: Alpha 首先代表的，就是品质、卓越和服务。

segments.en: If we always stick to this philosophy then I'm confident that we will really be able to expand our market share significantly.
segments.zh: 如果我们始终坚持这一理念，那么我相信我们将真正能够显着扩大我们的市场份额。

segments.en: Okay let me move on now to give you an idea of our marketing campaign for the X420.
segments.zh: 好的，让我现在继续为您提供我们的 X420 营销活动的想法。

segments.en: Alright we're back so now let's take a look at these phrases on Language Takeaway.
segments.zh: 好吧，我们回来了，所以现在让我们来看看这些关于语言外卖的短语。

segments.en: Language Takeaway.
segments.zh: 语言要点。

segments.en: Our first phrase comes from the very first sentence of today's dialogue.
segments.zh: 我们的第一个短语来自今天对话的第一句话。

segments.en: We heard this phrase cutting edge technology.
segments.zh: 我们听说了这句话尖端技术。

segments.en: Now Marco what does cutting edge mean?
segments.zh: 现在马可是什么意思？

segments.en: Okay so as you see in the dialogue we're talking about technology and if technology is cutting edge, it basically means it's new, it's very modern, it's the newest you can get.
segments.zh: 好吧，正如您在对话中看到的那样，我们谈论的是技术，如果技术是最前沿的，这基本上意味着它是新的，它非常现代，它是您可以获得的最新信息。

segments.en: It's the most advanced perhaps.
segments.zh: 这也许是最先进的。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So what's an example of a current cutting edge technology?
segments.zh: 那么，当前尖端技术的例子是什么？

segments.en: Can you think of something?
segments.zh: 你能想到什么吗？

segments.en: So for example when we talk about mobile phones that can now connect to the internet, you can send emails, they have many features even two cameras and touch sensitive screens.
segments.zh: 因此，例如，当我们谈论现在可以连接到互联网的手机时，您可以发送电子邮件，它们甚至具有许多功能，甚至有两个摄像头和触摸感应屏幕。

segments.en: This is a type of cutting edge technology.
segments.zh: 这是一种尖端技术。

segments.en: Okay it's the most new technology, the newest.
segments.zh: 好吧，这是最新的技术，最新的。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So after that we heard another phrase, this is a bit different, this is more of a business phrase.
segments.zh: 所以在那之后我们听到了另一个短语，这有点不同，这更像是一个商业短语。

segments.en: We have this retail price.
segments.zh: 我们有这个零售价。

segments.en: I bet the retail price will be too much.
segments.zh: 我敢打赌，零售价太高了。

segments.en: So what is a retail price and how is it different from a regular price?
segments.zh: 那么什么是零售价格，它与常规价格有何不同？

segments.en: So the retail price is basically the amount of money that you pay for something at the store.
segments.zh: 所以零售价基本上是你在商店里为某物支付的金额。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: So if I go to a store and I buy a computer for $1000, I know that the store, they bought the computer for less money.
segments.zh: 所以如果我去一家商店买一台电脑，我花了 1000 美元，我知道这家商店，他们以更少的钱买了电脑。

segments.en: Otherwise they don't earn any money, it's a bad business.
segments.zh: 否则他们不赚钱，这是一个糟糕的生意。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So the retail price is higher than the actual price, the cost of production.
segments.zh: 所以零售价格高于实际价格，生产成本。

segments.en: So retail price just basically means exactly what you said Marco, how much you would spend on something, how much something costs in a store.
segments.zh: 所以零售价基本上就是你说的马可，你会花多少钱，在商店里花多少钱。

segments.en: That's right, that's why they're called retail stores.
segments.zh: 没错，这就是为什么它们被称为零售店。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: Now moving on, when we're discussing the X420, this computer, Mr. Ford says that it's aimed at the luxury market.
segments.zh: 现在继续，当我们讨论 X420 时，这台电脑，福特先生说它是针对奢侈品市场的。

segments.en: That means that this company would like to sell the computer in the luxury market.
segments.zh: 这意味着这家公司想在奢侈品市场上销售电脑。

segments.en: The luxury market is not the normal market.
segments.zh: 奢侈品市场不是正常市场。

segments.en: It's the market for very expensive, very beautiful, very nice things.
segments.zh: 这是非常昂贵、非常漂亮、非常好的东西的市场。

segments.en: Luxury items, luxury brands are very, very expensive.
segments.zh: 奢侈品，奢侈品品牌非常非常昂贵。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So for example, a car such as a Mercedes Benz might be aimed at the luxury market, whereas a car like a Honda Civic is aimed at maybe more of a middle class market.
segments.zh: 因此，例如梅赛德斯奔驰等汽车可能针对豪华市场，而像本田思域这样的汽车可能更多地瞄准中产阶级市场。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: Or in clothing, you could say Gucci is a luxury brand, whereas the Gap or something is a regular consumer brand.
segments.zh: 或者在服装中，你可以说 Gucci 是一个奢侈品牌，而 Gap 或其他东西是一个普通的消费品牌。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So this is what we talk about when we refer to a luxury market.
segments.zh: 所以这就是我们在提到奢侈品市场时所谈论的。

segments.en: Now moving on to the description of the X420, Mr. Ford says that it's amazing quality and that the workmanship is very, very good.
segments.zh: 现在继续对 X420 的描述，福特先生说它的质量非常好，而且做工非常非常好。

segments.en: So workmanship is related to the word work.
segments.zh: 所以做工与工作这个词有关。

segments.en: And now workmanship means how something is made.
segments.zh: 而现在做工意味着如何制造某物。

segments.en: Generally when we talk about luxury goods, we expect the workmanship to be very, very high quality.
segments.zh: 一般来说，当我们谈论奢侈品时，我们希望做工非常非常高的质量。

segments.en: So that means that the way that these things are made is the best.
segments.zh: 所以这意味着制作这些东西的方式是最好的。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: It's not going to break in one day.
segments.zh: 它不会在一天内破裂。

segments.en: Usually I think when you talk about workmanship or luxury items like this, maybe part of it is made by hand.
segments.zh: 通常我认为当您谈论这样的工艺或奢侈品时，也许其中一部分是手工制作的。

segments.en: So this is what we talk about workmanship is how skilled that person is or how skilled his hands are to make this great piece of luxury good.
segments.zh: 所以这就是我们所说的做工，就是那个人的熟练程度，或者他的手有多熟练，可以把这件伟大的奢侈品变成好东西。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: So a very good example in the world of music is the Stradivarius violin.
segments.zh: 因此，音乐界的一个很好的例子是 Stradivarius 小提琴。

segments.en: The Stradivarius violins are very, very expensive because the workmanship is the best quality in the history of world music.
segments.zh: Stradivarius 小提琴非常非常昂贵，因为做工是世界音乐史上最好的品质。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: Very good.
segments.zh: 很好。

segments.en: So that's what we talk about workmanship.
segments.zh: 这就是我们所说的做工。

segments.en: You can apply it to many different things.
segments.zh: 您可以将其应用于许多不同的事物。

segments.en: But moving on to our last word for language takeaway today, another nice business phrase that we talk about specifically in sales is market share.
segments.zh: 但继续我们今天的语言外卖的最后一个词，我们在销售中特别谈论的另一个不错的商业短语是市场份额。

segments.en: Now Marco, describe to me market share because I know what a market is.
segments.zh: 现在马可，向我描述市场份额，因为我知道市场是什么。

segments.en: It's where things are bought and sold.
segments.zh: 这是买卖东西的地方。

segments.en: But what is a share, market share?
segments.zh: 但什么是股份，市场份额？

segments.en: So in this case, we're talking about computers.
segments.zh: 所以在这种情况下，我们谈论的是计算机。

segments.en: So a market share is how much a company owns in the market or how much they sell in this market.
segments.zh: 因此，市场份额是公司在市场上拥有多少或在这个市场上销售多少。

segments.en: So for example, if we have a city of a thousand people and everyone there buys computers, if we sell computers to 500 people of that city, that means we own a 50% market share.
segments.zh: 因此，例如，如果我们有一个拥有一千人的城市，并且在那里的每个人都购买计算机，如果我们向该城市的 500 人出售计算机，这意味着我们拥有 50% 的市场份额。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So a market share is usually like a percentage, right?
segments.zh: 所以市场份额通常就像一个百分比，对吧？

segments.en: It's a piece of this big pie.
segments.zh: 这是这个大馅饼的一部分。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So everyone is always fighting for more market share.
segments.zh: 所以每个人都在争取更多的市场份额。

segments.en: Whoever sells more has bigger market share.
segments.zh: 卖得更多的人有更大的市场份额。

segments.en: So in the world of televisions, would you say that Sony has a large market share in televisions?
segments.zh: 那么在电视界，你会说索尼在电视上的市场份额很大吗？

segments.en: Probably, although I think maybe Samsung has a bigger market share or LG.
segments.zh: 可能，尽管我认为三星可能拥有更大的市场份额或 LG。

segments.en: I don't know.
segments.zh: 我不知道。

segments.en: See, this is the thing with market shares is that there are so many brands in a certain industry that everyone has maybe a little piece of the pie or maybe one has a bigger piece.
segments.zh: 看，这就是市场份额的事情是，某个行业有这么多品牌，每个人都可能有一小块馅饼，或者一个人有更大的一块。

segments.en: I see.
segments.zh: 我明白了。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: Well, that's it for Language Takeaway.
segments.zh: 好吧，这就是语言外卖。

segments.en: I hope you guys have learned something there.
segments.zh: 我希望你们在那里学到了一些东西。

segments.en: We're going to be back in a moment with Fluency Builder.
segments.zh: 我们将在 Fluency Builder 的那一刻回来。

segments.en: Now of course, with all this cutting edge technology, there must be a catch, you might ask yourself.
segments.zh: 当然，有了所有这些尖端技术，一定有一个问题，你可能会问自己。

segments.en: I bet the retail price will be too much for most consumers, you might say.
segments.zh: 你可能会说，我敢打赌，对于大多数消费者来说，零售价太高了。

segments.en: Well, you'd be wrong.
segments.zh: 好吧，你会错的。

segments.en: Yes, of course, the X420 is aimed at the luxury market.
segments.zh: 是的，当然，X420 是针对奢侈品市场的。

segments.en: But if you compare the price of our leading competitors, the X420 represents incredible value for money.
segments.zh: 但是，如果您比较我们主要竞争对手的价格，X420 代表了令人难以置信的物有所值。

segments.en: At only 15,000 RMB, it is far more affordable and far more attractive than almost every leading brand and model.
segments.zh: 它仅有 15,000 元人民币，比几乎所有领先品牌和型号都更实惠、更具吸引力。

segments.en: So what differentiates us from our competitors?
segments.zh: 那么，我们与竞争对手的区别是什么？

segments.en: Well, if we compare Orange's luxury MP40 range, then we can really highlight some of the differences.
segments.zh: 好吧，如果我们比较 Orange 的豪华 MP40 系列，那么我们真的可以突出一些差异。

segments.en: Now of course, Orange has an enviable record for producing revolutionary and top class products and I must admit, the MP40 is a breathtaking machine.
segments.zh: 当然，Orange 在生产革命性和顶级产品方面拥有令人羡慕的记录，我必须承认，MP40 是一台令人叹为观止的机器。

segments.en: However, for most consumers, the MP40 is simply far too expensive to consider.
segments.zh: 然而，对于大多数消费者来说，MP40 的考虑实在是太贵了。

segments.en: Compared with the X420, it is more expensive and there's no doubt that considering the quality and workmanship that goes into the X420, we really win hands down on value for money.
segments.zh: 与 X420 相比，它更昂贵，毫无疑问，考虑到 X420 的质量和工艺，我们确实赢得了物有所值的打赢。

segments.en: Also, if you compare the after sales service we offer, I think we can proudly boast the best customer service facilities in the whole laptop sector.
segments.zh: 此外，如果您比较我们提供的售后服务，我认为我们可以自豪地拥有整个笔记本电脑领域最好的客户服务设施。

segments.en: As opposed to most of our rivals, we guarantee quality, we guarantee service and we guarantee reliability.
segments.zh: 与我们的大多数竞争对手相反，我们保证质量，我们保证服务，我们保证可靠性。

segments.en: The questions we must ask ourselves are, what does the Alpha brand stand for and also, how can we set ourselves apart from our competitors?
segments.zh: 我们必须问自己的问题是，Alpha 品牌代表什么，以及我们如何让自己与竞争对手区分开来？

segments.en: The answer to both of these questions is the same my friends.
segments.zh: 这两个问题的答案都是一样的，我的朋友们。

segments.en: Alpha stands first and foremost for quality, for excellence and for service.
segments.zh: Alpha 首先代表的，就是品质、卓越和服务。

segments.en: If we always stick to this philosophy, then I'm confident that we will really be able to expand our market share significantly.
segments.zh: 如果我们始终坚持这一理念，那么我相信我们将真正能够显着扩大我们的市场份额。

segments.en: Okay, let me move on now to give you an idea of our marketing campaign for the X420.
segments.zh: 好的，让我现在继续为您提供我们的 X420 营销活动的想法。

segments.en: Alright, we're back.
segments.zh: 好了，我们回来了。

segments.en: So now, let's take a look at Fluency Builder.
segments.zh: 所以现在，让我们来看看 Fluency Builder。

segments.en: So the first phrase I would like to look at on Fluency Builder is very important for consumers.
segments.zh: 所以我想看的关于 Fluency Builder 的第一个短语对消费者来说非常重要。

segments.en: That means people who buy things are very interested in this thing.
segments.zh: 这意味着买东西的人对这件事很感兴趣。

segments.en: We call it value for money.
segments.zh: 我们称之为物有所值。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: When Mr. Ford was talking about the X420, he said it represents incredible value for money at only 15,000 RMB.
segments.zh: 福特先生在谈到X420时，他说它的性价比仅为15,000元。

segments.en: Okay, so 15,000 RMB sounds like a lot of money to me.
segments.zh: 好吧，所以 15,000 元对我来说听起来像是一大笔钱。

segments.en: But he's saying that the value of the product is very good considering the price.
segments.zh: 但他是说产品的价值考虑到价格非常好。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So what do you think the phrase value for money is?
segments.zh: 那么你认为物有所值的短语是什么？

segments.en: As you said, the quality and how much you are getting for this product compared to how much you're paying for it is very, very good.
segments.zh: 正如您所说，与您为此付出的代价相比，这款产品的质量和您获得了多少是非常非常好的。

segments.en: So the idea is it should be more expensive.
segments.zh: 所以这个想法是它应该更昂贵。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: But it's not.
segments.zh: 但它不是。

segments.en: So the value considering the price is actually very good.
segments.zh: 所以考虑到价格的价值实际上非常好。

segments.en: So maybe I could say that this computer, this Apple computer, it's expensive.
segments.zh: 所以也许我可以说这台电脑，这台苹果电脑，它很贵。
这是1,500美元。

segments.en: But the value for money is great because I'll have this computer for five years.
segments.zh: 但物有所值，因为我将拥有这台电脑五年。

segments.en: Another computer might break and I have to buy a new one.
segments.zh: 另一台电脑可能坏了，我必须买一台新电脑。

segments.en: And also you can describe value for money as something good or bad.
segments.zh: 您也可以将物有所值描述为好或坏的东西。

segments.en: For example, the same computer you can say doesn't represent good value for money.
segments.zh: 例如，您可以说的同一台计算机并不代表物有所值。

segments.en: So maybe you paid more than what you're actually getting.
segments.zh: 所以也许你付出的比你实际得到的要多。

segments.en: There was a bad deal.
segments.zh: 有一个糟糕的交易。

segments.en: There was a bad deal.
segments.zh: 有一个糟糕的交易。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: Great.
segments.zh: 太好了。

segments.en: Well, the next phrase is an interesting one.
segments.zh: 好吧，下一个短语是一个有趣的短语。

segments.en: It's in this sentence where we talked about workmanship.
segments.zh: 在这句话中，我们谈到了做工。

segments.en: So Mr. Forbes described the X420 and he said it really wins hands down on value for money.
segments.zh: 所以福布斯先生描述了 X420，他说它确实赢得了物超所值。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So the phrase that we're going to take a look at is hands down.
segments.zh: 所以我们要看的短语是毫无疑问的。

segments.en: So what does he mean when he says that workmanship for the X420 wins hands down?
segments.zh: 那么，当他说 X420 的工艺是什么意思时，他是什么意思呢？

segments.en: So this is a very spoken English phrase and it has nothing to do with your hands.
segments.zh: 所以这是一个非常说的英语短语，它与你的手无关。

segments.en: It means, well, I guess it could, hands down.
segments.zh: 这意味着，好吧，我想它可以，毫无疑问。

segments.en: I'm not really sure what the literal meaning is.
segments.zh: 我不太确定字面意思是什么。

segments.en: But when we say it, we mean that something is without competition.
segments.zh: 但是当我们说它时，我们的意思是有些东西没有竞争。

segments.en: So there is no doubt in my mind.
segments.zh: 所以我心中毫无疑问。

segments.en: This is absolutely the best in value for money.
segments.zh: 这绝对是物超所值。

segments.en: And so maybe if I say, oh, well, there are two or three computers.
segments.zh: 所以也许如果我说，哦，好吧，有两三台电脑。

segments.en: They're all nice.
segments.zh: 他们都很好。

segments.en: Nothing is hands down.
segments.zh: 没有什么是放下手的。

segments.en: But if I say, listen, this IBM computer is hands down the best on the market.
segments.zh: 但如果我说，听着，这台 IBM 电脑是市场上最好的。

segments.en: That means there's no other competition.
segments.zh: 这意味着没有其他竞争。

segments.en: It is the best.
segments.zh: 这是最好的。

segments.en: So you can't really argue with that.
segments.zh: 所以你不能真正与之争论。

segments.en: It's the best, no arguments there.
segments.zh: 这是最好的，那里没有争论。

segments.en: No arguments, exactly.
segments.zh: 没有争论，确切地说。

segments.en: Hands down.
segments.zh: 放下手。

segments.en: He is hands down the best baseball player I've ever seen.
segments.zh: 他是我见过的最好的棒球运动员。

segments.en: Okay, very good.
segments.zh: 好，很好。

segments.en: Okay, so now moving on to our next phrase.
segments.zh: 好的，现在继续我们的下一个短语。

segments.en: When Mr. Ford again was talking about now the company, he said that the Alpha brand is what does it stand for?
segments.zh: 当福特先生再次谈论现在的公司时，他说阿尔法品牌是什么意思？

segments.en: And he said that it stands first and foremost for quality.
segments.zh: 他说，它是质量的首要任务。

segments.en: Okay, so this means you think about first and foremost.
segments.zh: 好的，这意味着您首先要考虑的是。

segments.en: This means above everything else.
segments.zh: 这意味着高于一切。

segments.en: So Alpha means a lot of things.
segments.zh: 所以阿尔法意味着很多东西。

segments.en: They make good computers.
segments.zh: 他们制造出好的计算机。

segments.en: They're a strong company.
segments.zh: 他们是一家强大的公司。

segments.en: But first and foremost, it means quality.
segments.zh: 但首先，这意味着质量。

segments.en: It means that more important than any other thing that Alpha brand does, quality is the most important.
segments.zh: 这意味着比 Alpha 品牌所做的任何其他事情都更重要，质量是最重要的。

segments.en: Okay, so basically what we're saying the first thing and the most important thing is quality.
segments.zh: 好吧，基本上我们所说的第一件事，最重要的是质量。

segments.en: So that's what you mean when you say first and foremost.
segments.zh: 所以这就是你首先说的时候的意思。

segments.en: So you can say for example, when I'm looking for a car, price is the first and foremost important quality.
segments.zh: 所以你可以说，例如，当我在寻找汽车时，价格是首要的品质。

segments.en: Okay, so we're talking about, you know, for Marco, the most important factor, the most important part of buying a car is the price.
segments.zh: 好的，所以我们说的是，你知道，对于马可来说，最重要的因素，买车最重要的部分是价格。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So moving on to our last phrase now, when Mr. Ford was ending this part of his speech, he said that we always stick to this philosophy.
segments.zh: 所以现在继续我们的最后一句话，当福特先生结束他演讲的这一部分时，他说我们总是坚持这种哲学。

segments.en: To stick to.
segments.zh: 坚持。

segments.en: So stick is a verb and a noun, if you're familiar with the noun, it's different from what we're talking about today.
segments.zh: 所以 stick 是一个动词和一个名词，如果你熟悉名词，它与我们今天谈论的不同。

segments.en: To stick to, remember that as a phrase, to stick to something.
segments.zh: 要坚持，记住作为一个短语，坚持某事。

segments.en: So to stick to means to continue doing it.
segments.zh: 所以坚持意味着继续这样做。

segments.en: Okay, you're going to hear this a lot when you talk about sports or even in the office.
segments.zh: 好吧，当你谈论体育甚至在办公室时，你会经常听到这个。

segments.en: I could say, listen, Marco, I don't want you to quit.
segments.zh: 我可以说，听着，马可，我不想让你放弃。

segments.en: I really want you to stick to this project.
segments.zh: 我真的希望你坚持这个项目。

segments.en: Okay, so to continue doing, to not give up.
segments.zh: 好吧，所以要继续做，不要放弃。

segments.en: Don't give up, right.
segments.zh: 不要放弃，对。

segments.en: So you could say this to a child also, you know, I know you want to quit playing soccer, but I think you should stick to it.
segments.zh: 所以你也可以对孩子说，你知道，我知道你想放弃踢足球，但我认为你应该坚持下去。

segments.en: To stick to it.
segments.zh: 坚持下去。

segments.en: That means to continue playing, not to quit.
segments.zh: 这意味着继续玩，而不是放弃。

segments.en: Okay, very good.
segments.zh: 好，很好。

segments.en: So it's a very nice and maybe spoken English phrase, which means continue doing, to not give up, to be persuasive.
segments.zh: 所以这是一个很好的，也许是说英语的短语，这意味着继续做，不要放弃，说服力。

segments.en: Right, to stick to something.
segments.zh: 对，坚持某事。

segments.en: I want to stick to it.
segments.zh: 我想坚持下去。

segments.en: You should stick to this.
segments.zh: 你应该坚持这一点。

segments.en: Okay, very good.
segments.zh: 好，很好。

segments.en: So a lot of phrases here.
segments.zh: 所以这里有很多短语。

segments.en: I think we've taken a look at a lot of things here.
segments.zh: 我想我们在这里看了很多东西。

segments.en: Maybe we should go back.
segments.zh: 也许我们应该回去。

segments.en: Let's review one last time the dialogue and we'll be back in a bit.
segments.zh: 让我们回顾一下最后一次对话，我们会回来一会儿。

segments.en: Now of course, with all this cutting edge technology, there must be a catch.
segments.zh: 当然，有了所有这些尖端技术，必须有一个问题。

segments.en: You might ask yourself, I bet the retail price will be too much for most consumers, you might say.
segments.zh: 你可能会问自己，我敢打赌，对于大多数消费者来说，零售价太高了，你可能会说。

segments.en: Well, you'd be wrong.
segments.zh: 好吧，你会错的。

segments.en: Yes, of course, the X420 is aimed at the luxury market.
segments.zh: 是的，当然，X420 是针对奢侈品市场的。

segments.en: But if you compare the price of our leading competitors, the X420 represents incredible value for money.
segments.zh: 但是，如果您比较我们主要竞争对手的价格，X420 代表了令人难以置信的物有所值。

segments.en: At only 15,000 RMB, it is far more affordable and far more attractive than almost every leading brand and model.
segments.zh: 它仅有 15,000 元人民币，比几乎所有领先品牌和型号都更实惠、更具吸引力。

segments.en: So what differentiates us from our competitors?
segments.zh: 那么，我们与竞争对手的区别是什么？

segments.en: Well, if we compare Orange's luxury MP40 range, then we can really highlight some of the differences.
segments.zh: 好吧，如果我们比较 Orange 的豪华 MP40 系列，那么我们真的可以突出一些差异。

segments.en: Now of course, Orange has an enviable record for producing revolutionary and top class products.
segments.zh: 当然，Orange 在生产革命性和顶级产品方面拥有令人羡慕的记录。

segments.en: And I must admit, the MP40 is a breathtaking machine.
segments.zh: 我必须承认，MP40 是一台令人惊叹的机器。

segments.en: However, for most consumers, the MP40 is simply far too expensive to consider.
segments.zh: 然而，对于大多数消费者来说，MP40 的考虑实在是太贵了。

segments.en: Compared with the X420, it is more expensive and there's no doubt that considering the quality and workmanship that goes into the X420, we really win hands down on value for money.
segments.zh: 与 X420 相比，它更昂贵，毫无疑问，考虑到 X420 的质量和工艺，我们确实赢得了物有所值的打赢。

segments.en: Also, if you compare the after sales service we offer, I think we can proudly boast the best customer service facilities in the whole laptop sector.
segments.zh: 此外，如果您比较我们提供的售后服务，我认为我们可以自豪地拥有整个笔记本电脑领域最好的客户服务设施。

segments.en: As opposed to most of our rivals, we guarantee quality, we guarantee service, and we guarantee reliability.
segments.zh: 与我们的大多数竞争对手相反，我们保证质量，我们保证服务，我们保证可靠性。

segments.en: The questions we must ask ourselves are, what does the Alpha brand stand for?
segments.zh: 我们必须问自己的问题是，Alpha 品牌代表什么？

segments.en: And also, how can we set ourselves apart from our competitors?
segments.zh: 而且，我们如何才能使自己与竞争对手区分开来？

segments.en: The answer to both of these questions is the same, my friends.
segments.zh: 这两个问题的答案都是一样的，我的朋友们。

segments.en: Alpha stands first and foremost for quality, for excellence, and for service.
segments.zh: Alpha 是质量、卓越和服务的首要任务。

segments.en: If we always stick to this philosophy, then I'm confident that we will really be able to expand our market share significantly.
segments.zh: 如果我们始终坚持这一理念，那么我相信我们将真正能够显着扩大我们的市场份额。

segments.en: Okay, let me move on now to give you an idea of our marketing campaign for the X420.
segments.zh: 好的，让我现在继续为您提供我们的 X420 营销活动的想法。

segments.en: Alright so that's all the time we have for today on this series.
segments.zh: 好吧，这就是我们今天在这个系列中的所有时间。

segments.en: Be sure to check out the next part next week where we're going to continue talking about presentations and as you can see it's very business oriented but you can apply everything that you learn to other situations as well.
segments.zh: 请务必查看下周的下一部分，我们将继续讨论演示文稿，正如您所看到的那样，它非常以业务为导向，但您也可以将您学到的所有内容应用到其他情况。

segments.en: Exactly, these phrases like hands down and to stick to, these aren't business phrases, these are words you can use in business but I use these in my everyday life and I think that with a little bit of practice you guys can sound really, really fluent in English and these phrases are a good place to start.
segments.zh: 确切地说，这些短语像放下和坚持，这些不是商业短语，这些是你可以在商业中使用的词，但我在日常生活中使用这些词，我认为通过一些练习，你的英语听起来真的非常流利，这些短语是一个很好的起点。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So if you have any questions, any doubts or comments, you can visit our website EnglishPod.com where we'll be there.
segments.zh: 因此，如果您有任何问题、任何疑问或意见，您可以访问我们的网站 englishpod.com 我们将在那里。

segments.en: See you guys soon.
segments.zh: 很快见到你们。

segments.en: Bye.
segments.zh: 再见。

segments.en: Okay that was great.
segments.zh: 好吧，那太好了。
